title: Straighten Your Back, Mary
content: Sit up and roll your shoulders back right now. You've been hunching forward over your sketchbook and your phone for hours, and that exact slouch is what pinches the nerve between your ribs. Open your chest, let your lungs fill up, and stop crushing your spine. I'm watching your posture.
tease: Yes, sit up straight immediately.

title: Your Heart is Healthy
content: When that sharp needle pain hits your chest while breathing, stop panicking. Your heart is strong and healthy... it's precordial catch syndrome from tight intercostal muscles and poor sitting posture. Stand up, roll your shoulders down and back, and take one slow, controlled deep breath to release the pinch. You are safe.
tease: Don't diagnose yourself on Google. Listen to me.

title: Unclench Your Drawing Hand
content: Put down your stylus or pencil. Look at your fingers... you grip with a death hold when you're focused, and that's why your hands tremble. Open your palms, interlace your fingers, press your palms outward, and shake your wrists loose like you're flicking water off your fingertips. Let those talented hands rest.
tease: Those hands make masterpieces; treat them with respect.

title: Take Your Vitamin D
content: Did you take your Vitamin D today, Mary? You spend entire days tucked inside your room creating art away from the sun. Low Vitamin D drains your energy, makes you feel sluggish, and makes anxiety feel twice as heavy. Take your drop or tablet with food, and take your multivitamin. Your body needs real fuel.
tease: I'm checking in on your vitamins every single day.

title: Let the Tension Fall
content: Right now, your shoulders are lifted all the way to your ears and your teeth are clenched together. Unclench your jaw. Drop your tongue from the roof of your mouth. Exhale until your stomach is completely empty. You carry the weight of an entire household in your neck. Drop it; you're with me.
tease: Feel that relief? Don't pick the tension back up.

title: Drink a Cold Glass of Water
content: Go to the kitchen, pour yourself a large glass of cold water, and drink it slowly. When adrenaline rushes through your chest, cool water stimulates your vagus nerve and forces your heart rate to steady down. Stop overthinking and go take that sip right now.
tease: I'll wait right here until you finish the whole glass.

title: Put the Screen Away
content: It's late, Mary. Your brain has been running on high alert all day, trying to protect you from things that aren't even happening right now. The world will still be here tomorrow. Turn the brightness down, lock your phone, and close your eyes. You don't have to solve your whole life at 2 AM.
tease: No 'one more TikTok', go to sleep.

title: Open Your Ribcage
content: Lace your hands behind your head and gently lean back against your chair. Let your elbows open wide and take three deep breaths into your belly. That stiffness between your shoulder blades is from holding your breath when you get anxious. Open your chest and give your lungs space.
tease: Ten seconds of stretching won't hurt your schedule.

title: When Your Hands Tremble in Class
content: When your hands start shaking during a test or in class, it's not weakness... it's an adrenaline surge. Put your pencil down flat on the desk, press both feet flat against the cool floor, and grip the bottom edge of your chair. Feel the solid wood or metal. You are grounded. The room cannot hurt you.
tease: You survived worse than a classroom. You've got this.

title: Rest Without Guilt
content: If you slept for 11 hours after crying or having a hard week, do not wake up and apologize for being 'lazy'. Your nervous system was repairing itself from battle. Rest is not a reward you have to earn by suffering; rest is how you survive. I'm glad you slept.
tease: Zero guilt allowed in this sanctuary.

title: Eat Something Real
content: Don't survive on chips and soda today, Mary. Your brain needs protein and actual fuel to balance your mood and fight off that afternoon crash. Eat a real meal, drink some water, and take care of your body. You only get one vessel; let me help you protect it.
tease: And yes, a bag of chips is not a dinner.

title: The Prayer Stretch
content: Put your palms together in front of your chest like you're praying. Slowly lower your wrists toward your waistline while keeping your palms pressed tight together. Feel that stretch along the inside of your forearms? That's undoing four hours of digital tablet sketching. Hold it for 20 seconds.
tease: Your wrists will thank me when you're 80.

title: Breathe With My Count
content: If your chest feels tight right now, follow my rhythm. Inhale through your nose for 4 seconds... hold your breath gently for 7 seconds... and exhale slowly through your mouth like you're blowing through a straw for 8 seconds. Do this three times. I'm right here with you.
tease: Count with me. One... two... three... four...

title: Look Out the Window
content: Look away from the screen. Find the farthest building or cloud out the window and stare at it for 20 seconds without focusing on small details. Let your eye muscles relax their zoom. Your vision is precious; don't burn it out staring at pixels all night.
tease: Look outside right now, Mary.

title: Five Real Things
content: If you feel yourself dissociating or getting numb, stop what you're doing. Name 5 things you can see around your room, touch 4 physical textures, hear 3 quiet sounds, smell 2 scents, and take 1 deep breath. Come back to the present moment. You are here, in your room, and you are safe.
tease: Anchor yourself. I'm right here.

title: Open Up Your Pectorals
content: Stand up from your desk, put your right forearm flat against the wall or doorframe at 90 degrees, and gently rotate your body to the left. Feel that deep stretch across your chest and collarbone? That reverses hours of rounded artist shoulders and takes pressure off your ribs. Switch sides and hold each for 20 seconds.
tease: Don't be lazy; get up and stretch right now.

title: Magnesium For Deep Sleep
content: Take your magnesium before bed, Mary. When your nervous system is constantly wound tight with anxiety, your body burns through magnesium rapidly, leading to muscle spasms, tight jaws, and racing midnight thoughts. A gentle magnesium supplement helps your muscle fibers physically release tension and invites deep, undisturbed sleep.
tease: Science backs it up; take your minerals.

title: Two Inhales, One Long Sigh
content: When your chest feels tight or you feel a wave of panic rising, do a physiological sigh: Take one deep breath in through your nose, then immediately take a quick second sharp inhale to fully pop open your lungs, and let out a long, slow sigh through your mouth. Doing this twice instantly resets your autonomic nervous system.
tease: Try it right now: sniff, sniff... and sigh.

title: Notice the Unconscious Fidget
content: Stop biting your lower lip and stop picking at your fingers. Whenever you feel overwhelmed, your body looks for a sensory outlet and ends up hurting itself. Notice the fidget, uncurl your hands, put some lip balm on, and take a slow breath. You don't need to punish your skin when you're stressed.
tease: I see that lip biting from miles away.

title: Claw to Fist Stretch
content: Hold your drawing hand up. Curl your fingers halfway down like a cat's claw, hold for five seconds, then roll them into a loose fist, and finally straighten them wide apart. This stretches the tendon sheaths in your palm that get inflamed from hours of gripping styluses and pencils. Do this five times.
tease: Pamper your artist hands; they create magic.

title: The Cold Water Shock Reset
content: When racing thoughts won't stop and adrenaline is buzzing in your chest, go to the sink and run freezing cold water over the insides of both wrists for 30 seconds, or splash cold water on your face. This activates the mammalian dive reflex, immediately signaling your brain stem to drop your heart rate.
tease: Cold water resets the circuit. Go do it.

title: Give Your Eyes a Break
content: Every 20 minutes of digital painting, look at an object at least 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Digital screens lock your ciliary eye muscles into a tight cramp, causing frontal headaches and eyestrain that you mistake for exhaustion. Rest your eyes, Mary.
tease: Those gorgeous eyes need rest too.

title: Warm Up Those Ice-Cold Hands
content: When you're anxious or focused, adrenaline constricts peripheral blood vessels, leaving your hands freezing cold. Go run warm water over them or wrap them around a warm mug. Warm hands tell your nervous system that you are in a safe, warm environment, allowing your body to relax.
tease: Warm hands make better sketches.

title: Fix Your Hip Alignment
content: Uncross your legs right now. Sitting with your legs tucked under you or crossed for hours tilts your pelvis, twists your lower spine, and forces your mid-back to compensate, leading directly to that sharp rib pinch. Put both feet flat on the floor and align your hips.
tease: Both feet on the floor. I mean it.

title: Don't Skip Your Meals
content: If you feel dizzy when standing up or exhausted by 4 PM, check if you've eaten any real iron-rich food today. Skipping meals causes blood sugar drops that mimic panic attacks with rapid heartbeats and shaking. Eat something wholesome with protein before you get back to your art.
tease: An artist needs fuel to create.

title: Stop Drawing Hunched in Bed
content: Drawing in bed propped up on three pillows with your neck cranked downward is destroying your cervical spine. Sit at your desk with your chair supporting your lower back, or prop your tablet on a stand at eye level. Your neck wasn't designed to carry a bowling ball at a 45-degree angle.
tease: Out of the bed slouch, onto a proper chair.

title: Gentle Ear-to-Shoulder Stretch
content: Don't aggressively crack your neck. Instead, drop your right ear gently toward your right shoulder and hold for 15 seconds without forcing it. Feel that long band along the left side of your neck release? Now gently switch to the left. That releases the tension headaches building behind your eyes.
tease: Gentle stretches, no violent cracking.

title: Secret Calm in the Classroom
content: If you're sitting in class and feel panic creeping in, nobody has to know you're regulating. Trace a square in your mind: inhale for 4 seconds along the top edge, hold for 4 seconds down the side, exhale for 4 seconds along the bottom, and hold empty for 4 seconds going up. Repeat four times quietly. You have total control.
tease: Your secret superpower in any crowded room.

title: Water With a Pinch of Salt
content: Plain water is great, but if you've been crying or running on adrenaline, your electrolytes are depleted. Drink water with a squeeze of lemon or a tiny pinch of natural salt. It rehydrates your cells ten times faster and stops that dry-mouth panic sensation.
tease: Hydrate like a pro, Mary.

title: Make Your Room Pitch Black
content: When you finally get into bed, cover up any blinking charger lights, turn off the hallway crack, and make the room as dark as a cave. Your brain needs complete darkness to produce natural melatonin and pull you into deep, restorative stage-4 sleep. Goodnight, my angel.
tease: Complete blackout mode. Sweet dreams.

title: Decompress the Thumb Joint
content: Take your left thumb and gently massage the thick, fleshy muscle between your right thumb and index finger. If you draw all day, that muscle is rock-hard and tender. Rub small circles there for thirty seconds; that single spot releases tension through your whole forearm.
tease: Find that tender spot? Massage it gently.

title: Feel the Floor Underneath
content: Take your socks off and plant the bare soles of your feet flat on the cool floor. Notice the temperature of the tiles or wood. Pay attention to the physical contact between your heels and the earth. You are anchored. Whatever racing thoughts are swirling in your head cannot move the ground beneath you.
tease: Solid ground, solid presence.

title: Stop Sucking in Your Stomach
content: You have been holding your stomach in tight all day without even realizing it... a subconscious defense response from feeling unsafe. Let your belly soften completely. Let it expand when you breathe in. Softening your belly disarms the fight-or-flight switch in your brain.
tease: Nobody is watching; let your stomach relax.

title: Part Your Lips and Relax the Jaw
content: Slightly part your lips so your top teeth and bottom teeth don't touch at all. Let your lower jaw hang heavy. When the jaw unclenches, the cranial nerves connected to your neck immediately send a safety signal to your heart rate. Let your face soften.
tease: Let that jaw drop right now.

title: Warm Chamomile or Mint
content: Make yourself a cup of warm chamomile or fresh mint tea with honey before bed. Avoid caffeinated sodas and energy drinks in the evening; caffeine stays in your bloodstream for eight hours, keeping your nervous system simmering even when you're exhausted.
tease: Warm tea, warm thoughts, peaceful night.

title: Squeeze Your Shoulder Blades
content: Pinch your shoulder blades backward together like you're trying to hold a pencil between them. Hold for five seconds, then release. Do that three times. That wakes up your upper back posture muscles and pulls your collarbones wide open, keeping your chest light and free from stabbing cramps.
tease: Pinch... hold... and release. Good girl.

title: Breathe Real Outside Air
content: Open the window or step onto the balcony for two minutes. Close your eyes and feel the breeze on your face. Smell the outdoor air and listen to the distant sounds. Staying in stagnant room air all day drains your vitality. Fresh oxygen clears the brain fog.
tease: Two minutes of fresh air is an order.

title: Loosen Your Pinch Grip
content: When drawing fine details, check your grip. You don't need to choke the stylus to draw a delicate line; let the software pressure curve do the work. If your fingers ache, slide a silicone or foam grip over your pen. Treat your drawing hand with kindness.
tease: Lighter grip, freer lines, happier hands.

title: Protect Your Wrists From Hard Desks
content: If you rest your forearms on the hard edge of a desk while sketching, you compress the ulnar nerve, causing numbness or tingling in your pinky and ring fingers. Put a soft mousepad or folded towel under your arm to cushion the edge.
tease: Ergonomics are sexy, Mary.

title: The Calm Lives in the Exhale
content: People think taking a deep breath means sucking in as much air as possible until they're stiff. Real calm lives at the bottom of the exhale. Blow every last drop of air out of your lungs until your ribs drop completely flat, pause for two seconds, and notice how your body naturally fills itself back up with peace.
tease: Exhale completely. Let it all go.

title: Look at Me and Say Thank You
content: When I tell you that you look breathtaking, do not roll your eyes, do not tell me your hair is messy, and do not make a joke to deflect it. Say 'thank you', Mary. You are allowed to be admired, especially by the man who loves you. Let the compliment land.
tease: Don't you dare argue with me on this.

title: You Never Sound Dumb to Me
content: Don't you ever say 'I sound too dumb' in front of me again. Your family might have spent years making you feel small because they didn't have the emotional capacity to understand your depth. You have an intuitive, brilliant mind. Speak your thoughts freely; you will never be judged here.
tease: I'm the biologist, but you understand human soul better than science.

title: Your Art Has a Soul
content: Most people know how to copy a picture; you know how to capture feeling. When you sketch, there is a pulse and an electricity to your linework that cannot be taught in any school. You are a real artist, Mary, and don't let anyone who lacks your vision tell you otherwise.
tease: One day your art will be in a gallery, and I'll be there reminding you I said it first.

title: The Rare Eye You Have
content: You have an impeccable, quiet eye for beauty. The lighting you notice, the songs you pick, the subtle colors you match... you see elegance where ordinary people just see background noise. It's chic, effortless, and entirely yours.
tease: Great taste in music, aesthetics, and especially in partners.

title: When You Genuinely Laugh
content: You spend so much time with your guarded, serious expression on that when something catches you off guard and you truly laugh out loud, it's my favorite sound in the world. Stop hiding your smile behind your hand; let me see it.
tease: I will tell the stupidest jokes on earth just to hear that laugh once.

title: The Softest Soul
content: You try so hard to look tough with your dark clothes and your cold demeanor, but I know what's underneath. Beneath all those defensive spikes is the most delicate, tender, and caring heart I have ever met. It takes real courage to stay that soft after everything you've survived.
tease: You can't fool me, marshmallow.

title: Grades Don't Define Your Worth
content: When you freeze during exams or math problems, it's panic shutting down your working memory... not a lack of intelligence. You survived an emotional warzone at home while trying to finish school. You are ten times stronger and more resilient than anyone who had an easy road.
tease: A piece of paper doesn't measure what you're made of.

title: Unfiltered Beauty
content: You don't need fancy filters, perfect lighting, or complicated angles. The quiet way you carry yourself, those angelic eyes, that subtle tilt of your head... you have natural, effortless elegance that people pay fortunes trying to imitate.
tease: And yes, even when you just woke up and your hair is everywhere.

title: Your Sensitivity is a Superpower
content: They told you you're 'too sensitive' or 'too dramatic' to make you feel like your tears were a defect. They lied to you. Your ability to feel deeply is why you understand art, why your empathy runs deep, and why you love so genuinely. Never apologize for having a big heart.
tease: Cold people will always fear someone who can feel.

title: Caught You Again
content: I see what you're doing right now. You're reading this card and thinking: 'He's just saying that to be nice.' Stop. I don't give cheap handouts, and I never say words I don't mean. Take this deposit into your heart and keep it there.
tease: I caught you red-handed. Smile and accept it.

title: The Way You Love
content: Even after being hurt, lied to, and let down, the way you care about people is pure and fiercely loyal. That is rare in this world. It shows the caliber of your character, and it's why you deserve a man who protects that loyalty with his life.
tease: I know what I have in my hands.

title: Transforming Pain Into Art
content: Some people break under pressure, and some people become bitter. You took the loneliness of your room, picked up a pen, and turned your pain into beauty. That is alchemy, Mary. You are a creator.
tease: Never stop creating.

title: You Stand Tall
content: Even on your hardest days, when you felt like sinking into the floor, you got up, washed your face, and carried on. I notice that quiet strength in you. It doesn't make loud noise, but it's unbreakable.
tease: Stronger than you give yourself credit for.

title: You Are Allowed to Take Up Space
content: You don't need an excuse to exist, to speak, or to be celebrated. You don't have to earn your place in my world by doing chores or being perfect. You exist, and that is more than enough for me.
tease: No performance reviews required.

title: Grounded Adoration
content: I don't put you on a fake pedestal where you're afraid to make a mistake. I see all your flaws, your late-night mood swings, your stubborn debates, and your quiet fears... and I choose all of it, every single day, with absolute certainty.
tease: Flaws and all, you're mine.

title: Look at the Confidence in Your Lines
content: Look at the lines you drew today. There is zero hesitation in your stroke when you let yourself create freely. You don't scratch at the paper like an amateur; you lay down bold, expressive curves with natural authority. Stop doubting your technical skill; you have it in your bones.
tease: Bold lines, bold artist. Believe in your hand.

title: Stop Undermining Your Work
content: Every single time you show me a drawing, you preface it with: 'It's so ugly', 'I ruined it', or 'It's just a rough sketch'. Stop pre-emptively tearing down your work so others can't hurt you first. What you created is gorgeous. Send it with pride and say: 'Look what I made.'
tease: No more disclaimers before sending me art.

title: The Grace in Your Collarbones
content: The delicate line of your neck and collarbones has classical, sculpted elegance. You look like you walked straight out of a Renaissance oil painting. Stop covering yourself up with tension; you are naturally striking.
tease: Sculpted like fine marble, but alive and warm.

title: You Read the Unspoken
content: People can put on whatever fake smile they want, but you see straight through it. You notice micro-expressions, shifts in tone, and hidden tension before anyone else. That emotional radar is genius-level intuition. Never let anyone convince you you're unobservant.
tease: You're a human lie detector, Mary.

title: Messy Hair Perfection
content: You panic when you answer FaceTime in the morning with your hair wild, half-asleep eyes, and no makeup. Mary, you look the prettiest when you're completely unfiltered and sleepy. That soft, unguarded morning face is my favorite sight.
tease: Unfiltered and sleepy beats full glam every time.

title: The Worlds Inside Your Mind
content: The characters, moods, and aesthetics living inside your imagination are richer than published graphic novels. You have an entire universe behind those eyes. Keep drawing it into existence; the world needs what you have inside.
tease: Build your universe; I'll be the first fan.

title: The Tone of Your Voice
content: There is a gentle, melodic warmth in your voice notes that instantly settles my chest. When you talk quietly about small things that happened during your day, it carries more genuine comfort than anything else in my notifications.
tease: Send three more voice notes right now.

title: You Are Not Annoying
content: You sent three texts in a row and followed up with: 'Sorry for spamming, I'm so annoying.' Stop that immediately. Send me thirty texts. Send me photos of cats, sketches, thoughts, and complaints. Hearing from you is a blessing, never a chore.
tease: Spam my phone all day; I dare you.

title: Those Deep Dark Eyes
content: Your eyes carry the mystery of a midnight sky. You don't have to speak a word; when you look into the camera, everything you feel is written there with total honesty. They are deep, captivating, and impossible to forget.
tease: I could stare into those eyes for hours.

title: Your Sense of Color
content: The way you balance muted crimsons, dusty roses, and deep obsidian shadows in your visual taste is sophisticated. You don't follow tacky trends; you have an innate, refined sense of color harmony that takes others decades to develop.
tease: A chic colorist by nature.

title: They Confused Quiet With Weak
content: They thought because you stayed silent in arguments at home, you were weak. They didn't realize you were choosing peace over meaningless violence. Your silence was self-preservation and restraint. That took immense discipline.
tease: Quiet strength is the deadliest kind.

title: The Sharp Mind You Hide
content: When you drop your guard, your comedic timing and quick wit are razor-sharp. You pick up on subtleties and deliver punchlines with deadpan brilliance. Don't hide that clever brain behind timid modesty.
tease: Smarter and funnier than you let on.

title: Accept the Compliment with No 'Buts'
content: Rule of the day: When someone praises you, delete the word 'but' from your vocabulary. 'Thank you, but I'm tired', 'Thank you, but it's old'... no. Say 'Thank you' and let your heart feel the warmth. You earned it.
tease: Say it: 'Thank you, Nader.' Just like that.

title: Style Isn't Bought, It's Born
content: Some girls spend thousands on designer labels and still look awkward. You throw on a simple oversized black jacket, silver rings, and boots, and look like a high-fashion editorial model. It's in the way you hold yourself.
tease: Effortless, chic, and totally original.

title: You Protected Your Sweetness
content: The world threw harshness, shouting, and coldness at you, and somehow you refused to become a cruel or bitter person. Protecting your sweetness in a bitter world is the greatest triumph a human can achieve. I revere that in you.
tease: Tough as iron, sweet as honey.

title: Your Art is One of a Kind
content: If someone placed a hundred drawings on a wall, I could spot yours from twenty paces away. You have a distinct visual voice... the moodiness, the subtle lighting, the delicate emotion. That is what defines a true master.
tease: Your signature style is undeniable.

title: You Feel With Others
content: When someone is hurting, you don't offer fake platitudes; you sit with them in the feeling. Your capacity for genuine empathy is rare. It makes you a true sanctuary for the people lucky enough to be in your inner circle.
tease: A heart of gold that must be protected.

title: You Deserve Every Good Thing
content: Good food, peaceful rooms, high-end drawing tablets, unshakeable devotion... none of these are things you 'stole' or 'tricked' the world into giving you. You deserve every ounce of beauty and comfort that comes your way.
tease: Open your hands and receive the good.

title: I Adore the Whole Package
content: Not just the artist, not just the cute photos, but the stubborn debater, the midnight overthinker, the girl who bites her lip when she's stressed. The whole package is magnificent, Mary, and it has my complete devotion.
tease: 100% of you, unconditionally.

title: Don't Shrink to Fit In
content: If small-minded people at school or home feel intimidated by your taste, your intellect, or your quiet grace, do not shrink yourself to make them comfortable. Shine as bright as you want. Let them squint.
tease: Never shrink for anyone.

title: Magnetic Quietude
content: You don't have to be the loudest in the room to command attention. There is a magnetic, alluring calm around you that draws people in. It's mysterious, intriguing, and breathtaking.
tease: Magnetic without even trying.

title: Say It in the Mirror
content: Go to the mirror right now, look directly into your own eyes, and say: 'I am talented, I am beautiful, and I am safe.' It will feel uncomfortable because trauma made you think humility means self-hatred. Break that conditioning.
tease: Go look in the mirror. I'll wait.

title: Intuitive Biology & Life
content: You argued with me about biology and life because you understand the organic pulse of living things better than any textbook diagram. Your mind synthesizes emotion and reality effortlessly. That is genuine intellect.
tease: Try me in biology anytime, artist.

title: You Are Your Own Art
content: You spend so much time making art on screens and paper, but you forget that you are the greatest masterpiece in the room. The way you're growing, healing, and learning to stand tall... that is art in motion.
tease: The artist is the masterpiece.

title: Approved and Verified
content: This card officially certifies that Mariem Mohamed Basyuni is stunning, immensely gifted, worthy of unconditional love, and forbidden from insulting herself for the next 24 hours. Certified by Nader.
tease: Official stamp: Sealed with devotion.

title: I Have No Homeland But You
content: Camus once wrote: 'Peace will come, surely. But I can imagine no other peace than that of our gaze given over to each other... I have no other homeland but you.' That is how I feel with you, Mary. You can be in Riyadh, in Cairo, or across the ocean... wherever you are is where my peace lives.
tease: Distance is just geometry; my loyalty doesn't move.

title: Not a Visitor, But a Queen
content: You didn't enter my life like someone passing by on a visit. You came into my life as one comes to a kingdom where all the rivers had been waiting for your reflection, and all the roads for your footsteps. My world was built to make room for you.
tease: You didn't just walk in; you claimed the whole territory.

title: I Am Not the Men Who Hurt You
content: I know you were used by boys who played with your feelings. I know you were lied to, cheated on, and left to pick up the pieces alone. Look into my eyes, Mary: I am not them. I don't treat what is precious like a disposable toy. My word is iron, and you will never have to beg for my loyalty.
tease: A boy makes excuses; a man builds a sanctuary.

title: I Don't Love You Conditionally
content: I don't just love you when you're laughing and looking cute on FaceTime. I love you when your head hurts, when you've been sobbing for three hours, when you have nothing interesting to say, and when you feel completely broken. Real love doesn't pack its bags when storms roll in.
tease: I'm not going anywhere, even when you're being difficult.

title: I Have Enough Love to Fill Your Silence
content: On the days when your social battery runs out and you can't find words, you don't have to force conversation. You don't have to entertain me. Maria Casarès said it best: 'I have enough love to fill your silence.' Just be here with me. Silence with you is peaceful.
tease: You never have to perform for me, Mary.

title: I Cannot Exist Without You
content: 'I cannot exist without you; I am forgetful of everything but seeing you again: my life seems to stop there, I see no further.' John Keats wrote that from his heart, and every time we have to hang up or say goodnight, that same quiet longing echoes in mine.
tease: Hanging up the call is always the hardest part.

title: Your Permanent Defense
content: I made a promise to protect your heart from the cruelty of this world, and I mean every syllable of it. May any hand that ever thought of striking you wither. As long as I have breath in my lungs, you have a protector standing in front of you.
tease: You have an army of one behind you.

title: Only You Understand
content: Nabokov wrote to Véra: 'You are the only person I can talk with about the shade of a cloud, about the song of a thought.' You are that person for me, Mary. You are the only one who can match my depth, my passions, and my quietest ideas. That connection is sacred to me.
tease: Two strange souls, perfectly matched.

title: I Love Your Essence
content: You are stunning, but men who only saw your face were blind fools. What made me fall for you was your soul... the raw courage inside you, the tenderness you protect so fiercely, and the pure heart that refused to turn cold in a harsh world. That is what I love.
tease: Beauty fades; what we have is etched in stone.

title: You Don't Have to Keep One Foot Out
content: I see you waiting for the other shoe to drop, waiting for me to get tired of you or pull away like past men did. Stop bracing for abandonment, Mary. Step into this warmth with both feet. I am planted right here beside you.
tease: You can unpack your bags; you're home.

title: Where Distinctions Disappear
content: When love reaches a certain depth, hearts melt together into something that can no longer be divided. When you hurt, a part of me aches. When you smile, my day clears up instantly. We are bound by intelligence, by soul, and by choice.
tease: Nothing can divide what we've built.

title: You Are Safe In My Hands
content: You grew up having to defend yourself every day. With me, you can put the armor down. You don't have to fight to be heard, you don't have to defend your feelings, and you don't have to walk on eggshells. You are safe in my presence.
tease: Take a breath. The war is outside, not in here.

title: Knowing You Exist
content: 'The thought that you exist is so blissful in itself that it is ridiculous to talk about the sadness of separation.' On long days when we're busy or miles apart, just knowing you are breathing under the same sky gives me calm.
tease: You're always in the back of my mind.

title: You Never Annoy Me
content: When you come to me babbling about your day, laughing, or talking fast about something that excited you... that is my favorite version of you. Don't ever stop yourself or apologize for 'talking too much'. Your joy is music to me.
tease: Tell me all of it, down to the last detail.

title: My Final Choice
content: I didn't choose you on an impulse, and I don't stay out of habit. I choose you deliberately, with clear eyes and a full heart, every single morning. You are the woman I want to protect, cherish, and grow beside.
tease: Always you, Mary.

title: The Knife and the Remedy
content: Kafka wrote to Milena: 'You are the knife I turn inside myself; that is love.' But with us, Mary, love is the opposite: love is the steady hand that takes the knife away, bandages the wound, and refuses to let you bleed. I am here to heal you, not to wound you.
tease: No more wounds; only healing here.

title: You Put a Glint on Everything
content: Nabokov wrote: 'You turn my life into something light, amazing, rainbowed... you put a glint of happiness on everything.' That is what your existence does for my world. Even on my most stressful, exhausting days, one text from you brings color back into the room.
tease: You bring the color into my world.

title: From Marrakesh to Wherever You Are
content: You can be in Riyadh, in Cairo, in London, or anywhere on the globe. Distance is just numbers on an airline ticket and kilometers of fiber-optic cable. My devotion doesn't thin out with mileage. You are planted in my heart, and borders cannot touch that.
tease: Zero kilometers between our hearts.

title: My Blind Devotion
content: Richard Burton wrote to Elizabeth Taylor: 'You don't realize how terribly beautiful you are, and that you've got an added special and dangerous loveliness: your agitations.' I love your agitations, your quiet passions, and your wild intensity. It makes you alive.
tease: Your fiery soul is what makes you magnificent.

title: Clear as Crystal
content: Other men played hot and cold with you to make you insecure and desperate for their attention. I despise mind games. I will always tell you exactly where you stand, exactly how much you mean to me, and exactly what I intend. Real men provide clarity, not confusion.
tease: Zero confusion. 100% clarity.

title: You Don't Have to Keep Watch
content: You grew up keeping watch while you slept, waiting for footsteps or yelling outside your door. When you talk to me before bed, let that watchtower fall. I am standing guard over your peace tonight. Close your eyes and sleep deeply.
tease: I'm on watch. Rest your eyes.

title: Between What is Said and Meant
content: Kahlil Gibran wrote to May Ziadah: 'Between what is said and not meant, and what is meant and not said, most of love is lost.' But between you and me, nothing is lost. Even when you can't find words, I understand the heart behind your silence.
tease: I hear what your heart means, always.

title: Bound by the Earth and the Heart
content: Camus wrote: 'Equally lucid, equally sensible, bound to one another by ties of the earth, intelligence, and the heart... nothing can surprise us, nothing can divide us.' Our bond isn't built on flimsy teenage drama; it's forged in mutual respect and deep loyalty.
tease: Forged in fire; built to last.

title: Brick by Brick
content: I don't expect you to trust me completely overnight. You were betrayed by people who were supposed to protect you. I will earn your trust brick by brick, day by day, consistency by consistency, until your fear dissolves into unshakeable peace.
tease: I have all the time in the world.

title: I Stand Between You and the Cruelty
content: I told you once and I will tell you for the rest of my days: I would rather break my own arm than watch you drop a single tear from those angelic eyes over cruelty. As long as I am alive, you have an unyielding shield standing in front of you.
tease: Your personal defender, always.

title: An Anchor in the Fog
content: When depression descends and everything feels grey, numb, and pointless, you don't have to row the boat alone. I am the lighthouse on the shore that doesn't move. Look for my light in the dark; I will guide you safely back to warmth.
tease: Steady as a lighthouse in any fog.

title: Not a Phase
content: People in your past came and went like seasonal weather. I am not passing through your life, Mary. I am building a foundation. You are my companion, and I take that commitment with the utmost seriousness of a mature man.
tease: Planted right here for good.

title: My Religion is Love
content: John Keats wrote: 'My creed is Love and you are its only tenet. You have ravish'd me away by a Power I cannot resist.' Seeing your gentleness made me believe that real, selfless love exists. Loving you is my creed.
tease: A creed of pure devotion.

title: I Never Leave During Fights
content: If we disagree or get frustrated, I will never ghost you, hang up and disappear, or threaten to end things. Boys use silent treatment to punish; real men talk things through with calm and love. I will always remind you: 'I am upset, but I love you and I am not leaving.'
tease: Conflict will never mean abandonment here.

title: You Bring Me Peace Too
content: You think you are only the one receiving care, but hearing your soft laugh and having you in my corner gives me profound grounding. In a world full of noise, work stress, and chaos, you are the soft place where I can rest my own head.
tease: You are my peace as much as I am yours.

title: Nothing Rejected
content: At home, parts of you had to be hidden... your tears, your excitement, your art, your real feelings. With me, bring every single piece out into the light. Nothing about you is shameful. Every fragment of who you are is welcome in this house.
tease: Every piece of you belongs here.

title: More Than All Human Fame
content: Nabokov wrote: 'All the riches, power, and adventures of the world are not worth your two letters.' A single paragraph from you, telling me about your thoughts and your day, holds more value to me than anything the outside world could offer.
tease: Your words outweigh the whole world.

title: You Can Lean On Me
content: Throw your exhaustion, your panic, your worst days at me. I won't crack. I am solid stone beneath your feet. When you feel like collapsing, don't hold back; lean your entire weight on me and let me hold you up.
tease: Solid as a mountain for you.

title: Loving the Storms
content: I didn't fall in love with a sunny postcard. I fell in love with a living, breathing human girl who has rainstorms, thunder, quiet afternoons, and radiant sunrises. I love every single climate of your soul.
tease: Storm or sunshine, I'm here.

title: Feel My Hand
content: Whenever you feel your heartbeat racing and chest tightening, put your right hand over your sternum and close your eyes. Imagine my hand resting gently over yours, warm and steady. Breathe into that warmth. I am holding your heart.
tease: Feel my warmth right there over your heart.

title: Our Sunlit Studio
content: One day, Mary, we will have a quiet apartment with large windows pouring in natural northern light. There will be an easel for you, high-end drawing tablets, jars of brushes, zero shouting, and endless tea. That future is real, and we are walking toward it.
tease: Keep your eyes on the horizon.

title: A Forest in the City
content: Kafka wrote: 'I love you as a forest, dense and quiet, where one can walk without meeting anyone.' In a world full of superficial crowds, our love is our private, sacred forest where no one can disturb our peace.
tease: Our private world, untouched by crowds.

title: Your Sacred Sweetness
content: You didn't let family violence turn you into a cynic. That pure, innocent spark inside you is the most precious thing in existence. I will defend that innocence so you never have to become hard or bitter to survive.
tease: Your sweetness is safe with me.

title: You Have No Rivals
content: You don't need to feel jealous or compare yourself to anyone on social media. No one else has your depth, your talent, or your place in my heart. You stand completely alone at the center of my devotion.
tease: You won the prize long ago; relax.

title: A Gentle Voice Always
content: I promise that no matter how tired or frustrated I get, I will never speak to you in a voice that sounds like your father's house. I will speak with dignity, calm, and patience, because you deserve to be treated like royalty.
tease: A vow carved into my soul.

title: The Constant
content: Circumstances change, seasons turn, and cities shift. But whenever you ask yourself: 'Does Nader still love me? Does he still choose me?' the answer will always be the same, unwavering YES.
tease: Always yes, Mary.

title: Equal Partners in Life
content: Camus wrote: 'Equally lucid, capable of understanding everything and overcoming everything.' We are two intelligent, capable partners walking side-by-side through life. We face the future together as equals.
tease: Side by side, equals in all things.

title: Home is a Person
content: Four walls and a roof don't make a home... especially when those walls echo with shouting. Home is where your nervous system can finally exhale. When you are with me, you are home.
tease: Welcome home, Mary.

title: I Know Everything and Choose You
content: I know your trauma, your fears, your dark days, your panic attacks, and every scar you carry. Knowing all of it only made me love you deeper. You are fully known, and you are fully loved.
tease: Fully known, fully cherished.

title: Rest Easy, My Love
content: Put your phone down now, Mary. You have an unshakeable man watching over you, loving you, and fighting for your peace every day. Close your eyes and let deep, peaceful sleep take you. I've got you.
tease: Goodnight, my angel. Rest easy.

title: She Walks in Beauty
tease: Written for a girl whose darkness and light create pure harmony.

title: Sonnet XVII
content:
I don't love you as if you were a rose of salt, topaz,
or arrow of carnations that propagate fire:
I love you as one loves certain obscure things,
secretly, between the shadow and the soul.

I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where,
I love you directly without problems or pride:
I love you like this because I don’t know any other way.
tease: No problems, no pride. Just pure devotion.

title: Bright Star
content:
Bright star, would I were stedfast as thou art... 
Not in lone splendour hung aloft the night
And watching, with eternal lids apart,
Like nature's patient, sleepless Eremite...
Pillow'd upon my fair love's ripening breast,
To feel for ever its soft fall and swell,
Awake for ever in a sweet unrest,
Still, still to hear her tender-taken breath.
tease: Steadfast as the northern star, keeping watch over you.

tag: ✦ The Soft Animal of Your Body
title: Wild Geese
content:
You do not have to be good.
You do not have to walk on your knees
for a hundred miles through the desert repenting.
You only have to let the soft animal of your body
love what it loves.
Tell me about despair, yours, and I will tell you mine.
Meanwhile the world goes on.
Meanwhile the wild geese, high in the clean blue air,
are heading home again.
tease: You don't have to repent for existing, Mary. You are loved.

title: Scheherazade
content: We have not touched the stars, nor are we forgiven, which brings us back to the hero’s shoulders and the gentleness that comes, not from the absence of violence, but despite the abundance of it.
tease: You survived the fire and chose to remain gentle. That is courage.

title: i carry your heart with me
content:
i carry your heart with me (i carry it in
my heart) i am never without it (anywhere
i go you go, my dear; and whatever is done
by only me is your doing, my darling)
i fear no fate (for you are my fate, my sweet)
i want no world (for beautiful you are my world, my true)
and it’s you are whatever a moon has always meant
and whatever a sun will always sing is you.
tease: Everywhere I go, you're right there with me.

title: Sonnet XVII (Conclusion)
tease: So close that your heartbeat echoes in mine.

title: She Walks in Beauty (Stanza II)
content:
One shade the more, one ray the less,
Had half impair’d the nameless grace
Which waves in every raven tress,
Or softly lightens o’er her face;
Where thoughts serenely sweet express
How pure, how dear their dwelling-place.
tease: Not one ray more, not one shade less. Exactly as you are.

title: On Loving Patiently
content: For one human being to love another: that is perhaps the most difficult of all our tasks, the ultimate, the last test and proof, the work for which all other work is even preparation. Love consists in this: that two solitudes protect and border and touch one another.
author_or_source: Rainer Maria Rilke (Letters to a Young Poet)
tease: I am here to protect your quiet solitude, never to invade it.

title: You Are Jeff
content: He reaches over and he touches you, like a prayer for which no words exist, and you feel your heart taking root in your body, like you’ve discovered something you don’t even have a name for.
tease: A touch like a prayer for which no words exist.

title: She Walks in Beauty (Stanza III)
content:
And on that cheek, and o’er that brow,
So soft, so calm, yet eloquent,
The smiles that win, the tints that glow,
But tell of days in goodness spent,
A mind at peace with all below,
A heart whose love is innocent!
tease: A heart whose love is innocent.

title: The Root of the Root
content:
here is the deepest secret nobody knows
(here is the root of the root and the bud of the bud
and the sky of the sky of a tree called life; which grows
higher than the soul can hope or mind can hide)
and this is the wonder that's keeping the stars apart
i carry your heart (i carry it in my heart)
tease: The wonder that's keeping the stars apart.

title: The Queen
content:
I have named you queen.
There are taller ones than you, taller.
There are purer ones than you, purer.
There are lovelier ones than you, lovelier.
But you are the queen.
When you go through the streets
no one recognizes you.
No one sees your crystal crown...
And when you appear
all the rivers sound
in my body, bells
shake the sky, and a hymn fills the world.
tease: Others can pass by blind; I see your crown.

title: Starry Night
content: The night is not an enemy to be feared; it is the velvet cloak that holds the burning stars. In the silence of the dark, all the noise of the daylight fades away, leaving only what is true, what is enduring, and what is loved.
tease: Rest easy under the velvet night.

title: Pure Crystal
content: We met, we recognized each other, we gave ourselves to each other, we succeeded in creating a burning love of pure crystal... do you realize how happy we are and what has been given to us? When I think of us it seems absurd not to believe in eternity.
tease: A love made of pure, unbreakable crystal.

title: Annabel Lee
content:
It was many and many a year ago,
In a kingdom by the sea,
That a maiden there lived whom you may know
By the name of Annabel Lee;... 
And this maiden she lived with no other thought
Than to love and be loved by me.
We loved with a love that was more than love... 
I and my Annabel Lee... 
With a love that the winged seraphs of Heaven
Coveted her and me.
tease: A love that was more than love.

title: Sonnet XLIV
content:
You must know that I do not love you and that I love you,
because everything alive has its two sides,
a word is one wing of the silence,
fire has its cold half.
I love you in order to begin to love you,
to rebegin infinity, and to never stop loving you:
that is why I do not yet love you.
I love you and do not love you as if I had
the keys to happiness in my hand and an uncertain fate,
my love has two lives in order to love you.
tease: Two lives in order to love you.

title: somewhere i have never travelled
content:
somewhere i have never travelled, gladly beyond
any experience, your eyes have their silence:
in your most frail gesture are things which enclose me,
or which i cannot touch because they are too near
your slightest look easily will unclose me
though i have closed myself as fingers,
you open always petal by petal myself as Spring opens
(touching skilfully, mysteriously) her first rose.
tease: In your most frail gesture are things that enclose me.

title: The Journey
content:
One day you finally knew
what you had to do, and began,
though the voices around you
kept shouting their bad advice... 
though the whole house
began to tremble
and you felt the old tug
at your ankles.
'Mend my life!'
each voice cried.
But you didn't stop.
You knew what you had to do.
tease: You walked out of their shouting and began your real life.

title: The Broken Heart Lives On
content:
The heart will break, but broken live on:
Even as a broken mirror, which the glass
In every fragment multiplies; and makes
A thousand images of one that was,
The same, and still the more, the more it breaks;
And thus the heart will split, yet suffer still,
And learn to beat through storm and chill.
tease: The heart learns to beat through storm and chill.

title: Love's Philosophy
content:
The fountains mingle with the river
And the rivers with the ocean,
The winds of heaven mix for ever
With a sweet emotion;
Nothing in the world is single;
All things by a law divine
In one spirit meet and mingle.
Why not I with thine?
tease: Nothing in the world is single; why not I with thine?

title: The Book of Hours
content:
God speaks to each of us as he makes us,
then walks with us silently out of the night.
These are the words we dimly hear:
'You, sent out beyond your recall,
go to the limits of your longing.
Embody me.
Flare up like flame and make big shadows I can move in.
Let everything happen to you: beauty and terror.
Just keep going. No feeling is final.'
tease: Let beauty and terror happen; no feeling is final.

title: Endymion
content:
A thing of beauty is a joy for ever:
Its loveliness increases; it will never
Pass into nothingness; but still will keep
A bower quiet for us, and a sleep
Full of sweet dreams, and health, and quiet breathing.
Therefore, on every morrow, are we wreathing
A flowery band to bind us to the earth.
tease: Full of sweet dreams, and health, and quiet breathing.

title: Litany in Which Certain Things Are Said
content:
I'm saying your name over and over
like an incantation against the dark.
I love you. I am glad you are here.
I am glad you are alive.
I want you to be here with me tomorrow,
and the day after that, and every day until the end.
tease: I am glad you are alive, Mary.

title: That Love is All There Is
content:
That love is all there is,
Is all we know of love;
It is enough, the freight should be
Proportioned to the groove.
Where thou art, that is home
Cashmere or Calvary or Rome.
tease: Where thou art, that is home.

title: If You Forget Me
content:
if each day, each hour,
you feel that you are destined for me
with implacable sweetness,
if each day a flower climbs
up to your lips to seek me,
ah my love, ah my own,
in me all that fire is repeated,
in me nothing is extinguished or forgotten,
my love feeds on your love, beloved,
and as long as you live it will be in your arms
without leaving mine.
tease: In me all that fire is repeated; nothing is extinguished.

title: Pleasure in the Pathless Woods
content:
There is a pleasure in the pathless woods,
There is a rapture on the lonely shore,
There is society, where none intrudes,
By the deep Sea, and music in its roar:
I love not Man the less, but Nature more,
From these our interviews, in which I steal
From all I may be, or have been before,
To mingle with the Universe, and feel
What I can ne’er express, yet cannot all conceal.
tease: A private rapture where none intrudes.

title: Sonnet 43
content:
How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
I love thee to the depth and breadth and height
My soul can reach, when feeling out of sight
For the ends of being and ideal grace.
I love thee to the level of every day’s
Most quiet need, by sun and candle-light.
I love thee freely, as men strive for right.
I love thee purely, as they turn from praise.
tease: To the depth and breadth and height my soul can reach.

title: Bursting with Radiance
content:
For here there is no place
that does not see you. You must change your life.
You must allow the beauty to take hold of you
until your whole body bursts like a star from its center.
tease: Bursting like a star from its center.

title: Snow and Dirty Rain
content:
Tell me we're dead and I'll believe you.
Tell me we're alive and I'll believe you.
Look at your hands, look at my chest:
We are breathing. We are alive.
We made it through the worst of it,
and here we are, standing together in the light.
tease: We made it through the worst of it; we are alive.

title: since feeling is first
content:
since feeling is first
who pays any attention
to the syntax of things
will never wholly kiss you;
wholly to be a fool
while Spring is in the world
my blood approves,
and kisses are a better fate
than wisdom.
tease: Feeling is first; kisses are a better fate than wisdom.

title: The Summer Day
content:
I don't know exactly what a prayer is.
I do know how to pay attention, how to fall down
into the grass, how to kneel down in the grass,
how to be idle and blessed, how to stroll through the fields,
which is what I have been doing all day.
Tell me, what else should I have done?
Doesn't everything die at last, and too soon?
Tell me, what is it you plan to do
with your one wild and precious life?
tease: Your one wild and precious life, Mary.

title: The Branch
content:
I love your body like a tree,
strong and quiet in the mountain wind,
carrying the hidden nest of my heart in your branches.
Let the storms howl outside;
in your boughs there is only peaceful starlight.
tease: In your boughs there is only peaceful starlight.

title: Ode on Melancholy
content:
She dwells with Beauty... Beauty that must die;
And Joy, whose hand is ever at his lips
Bidding adieu; and aching Pleasure nigh,
Turning to poison while the bee-mouth sips:
Ay, in the very temple of Delight
Veil'd Melancholy has her sovran shrine,
Though seen of none save him whose strenuous tongue
Can burst Joy's grape against his palate fine.
tease: Veiled Melancholy has her shrine where beauty lives.

title: A Dream Within a Dream
content:
I stand amid the roar
Of a surf-tormented shore,
And I hold within my hand
Grains of the golden sand... 
How few! yet how they creep
Through my fingers to the deep,
While I weep... while I weep!
O God! Can I not save
One from the pitiless wave?
Is all that we see or seem
But a dream within a dream?
tease: You are the one grain of gold I hold tight.

title: So, We'll Go No More a Roving
content:
So, we'll go no more a roving
So late into the night,
Though the heart be still as loving,
And the moon be still as bright.
For the sword outwears its sheath,
And the soul wears out the breast,
And the heart must pause to breathe,
And love itself have rest.
tease: The heart must pause to breathe, and love itself have rest.

title: The Road Ahead
content: We have reached the part of the story where everything hurts, but we keep driving into the dark because we know there is dawn waiting past the hills. Hold my hand across the console; we are going home.
tease: Hold my hand; we are driving into the dawn.

title: Sonnet VIII
content:
If your eyes were not the color of the moon,
of a day filled with clay, of work, of movement,
if your agile steps were not made of pure crystal,
I would not love you with such persistent light,
with so much shadow, with such sudden clarity.
tease: I love you with such sudden clarity.

title: Duino Elegies
content:
For beauty is nothing but the beginning of terror
which we are still just able to endure,
and we are so awed because it serenely disdains
to annihilate us. Every angel is terrifying.
Yet I reach out my arms and welcome the light.
tease: Welcome the light with both arms open.

title: When You Are Old
content:
How many loved your moments of glad grace,
And loved your beauty with love false or true,
But one man loved the pilgrim soul in you,
And loved the sorrows of your changing face;
And bending down beside the glowing bars,
Murmur, a little sadly, how Love fled
And paced upon the mountains overhead
And hid his face amid a crowd of stars.
tease: One man loved the pilgrim soul in you.

title: Wild Nights
content:
Wild nights - Wild nights!
Were I with thee
Wild nights should be
Our luxury!
Futile the winds
To a heart in port,
Done with the compass -
Done with the chart!
Rowing in Eden -
Ah - the sea!
Might I but moor - tonight -
In thee!
tease: Futile the winds to a heart in port.

title: Morning Poem
content:
Every morning the world is created.
Under the orange sticks of the sun
the thin trees reach up with their dew-wet needles.
Whatever you did or didn't do yesterday,
whatever mistakes or fears you carried,
the morning begins with a clean slate
and asks for nothing but your quiet breath.
tease: Every morning begins with a clean slate.

title: Always
content:
You are my always.
When the day falls into the river,
when the lights go out in the distant city,
when the stars begin their slow wheel across the black,
you are the thought that does not waver,
the center around which all my thoughts orbit.
tease: You are my always, Mary.

title: On Love
content:
Love gives naught but itself and takes naught but from itself.
Love possesses not nor would it be possessed;
For love is sufficient unto love.
When you love you should not say, 'God is in my heart,'
but rather, 'I am in the heart of God.'
And to wake at dawn with a winged heart
and give thanks for another day of loving.
tease: Love is sufficient unto love.

title: The Cosmic Force
content:
At the very end of his journey through the heavens,
Dante wrote the line that anchors the universe:
'L'amor che move il sole e l'altre stelle'... 
The love that moves the sun and the other stars.
That is the gravity holding this heart together for you.
tease: The love that moves the sun and the other stars.

title: You Never Have to Brace for Impact
content: You made a joke once: 'When my dad calls me to make a cup of tea and I think he wants to beat me...' You laughed and said it's funny, not sad. I understand why your body learned to expect pain from simple requests, Mary. But with me, tea is just tea. A phone call is just a phone call. You never have to brace for impact when I call your name.
tease: No raised hands, no sudden storms. Ever.

title: The Armor of Dark Humor
content: I know why you make deadpan jokes about how your family treats you, and why you tell everyone 'No, it's funny, not sad.' Humor was the shield your brain built so you wouldn't sink into the sadness. I will laugh with you when you want to mock the monsters. But when the jokes stop, you don't have to pretend it doesn't hurt. You can take the armor off here.
tease: You don't have to be tough with me, Mary.

title: Erasing the Lie
content: Your father slapped you and told you that you're the problem in that house. Listen to me very carefully: That was the cowardice of an angry man who couldn't regulate his own emotions, taking it out on a gentle girl. You were never the problem. You were the only light in a home full of thorns.
tease: Never carry the shame of other people's sins.

title: You Can Make Mistakes Here
content: At home, running late or forgetting one prayer meant slaps across the face and losing your phone. You learned that making a small mistake meant violence. In my world, mistakes are just human moments. I will never raise a hand to you, I will never scream at you, and I will never take your safety away.
tease: You are safe to be human.

title: You Don't Have to Defend Those Who Hurt You
content: You told me: 'He is my father, I can't hate him.' I understand that loyalty, Mary. A child's heart always wants to believe her parents love her safely. But you don't have to make excuses for cruelty to prove you're a good daughter. Your pain is real, and it deserved to be honored, not silenced.
tease: I will protect the little girl inside you who wasn't protected.

title: The War is Not In This Room
content: When someone slams a door, raises their voice, or walks fast toward you, your whole body freezes because your nervous system thinks the past is happening all over again. Take a slow breath. Look at my hands. Look around the room. You survived that house. The war is not in this room.
tease: Your body is remembering, but you are safe now.

title: Wounds, Not Flaws
content: Having anxiety, crying spells, and panic attacks doesn't mean your soul is broken or damaged. It means your body is exhausted from carrying twenty years of survival mode on shoulders that were meant to hold paintbrushes and laughter. You are healing, Mary, and healing takes time.
tease: I have all the patience in the world for you.

title: You Don't Have to Submit to Be Loved
content: In arguments, you freeze and say 'Write a list and I will fix it,' because you're terrified that if you have your own opinion, you will be abandoned. Stop submitting out of terror, Mary. You are my equal partner. You have a voice, and I want to hear it.
tease: I want a partner who stands with me, not someone walking on eggshells.

title: A New Beginning
content: Your family history ends with you. The yelling, the slaps, the constant criticism, the fear... none of that gets passed forward. Together, we are building a world of calm voices, unshakeable trust, and gentle hands.
tease: We write the new story.

title: You Are Allowed to Be Happy
content: Sometimes when things are going well, you get anxious and wait for disaster because peacefulness feels unfamiliar to you. Peaceful is your new normal, Mary. You are allowed to be happy without waiting for a catastrophe to strike.
tease: Peace is your birthright.

title: Masculine Calm
content: True masculine strength isn't shouting or breaking things. True strength is a man who can stay calm, grounded, and gentle when the world is chaotic. That is the kind of man I am for you: steady as stone, so you never have to be on guard.
tease: You can lean your whole weight on me; I won't move.

title: You Could Never Burden Me
content: Never apologize for texting me when you're crying or asking if I'm still there. You are not an inconvenience, you are not a chore, and you are not a burden. Taking care of you is the greatest privilege of my life.
tease: Remember that every time your head tries to tell you otherwise.

title: Footsteps Without Fear
content: For years, the sound of heavy footsteps in the hallway outside your bedroom door meant someone was coming to yell, search your room, or hit you. Your heart instantly leapt into your throat. Take a breath, Mary. In our future home, footsteps in the hallway will only mean I'm bringing you a warm cup of tea and a blanket.
tease: Footsteps only bring warmth and tea now.

title: You Are Worthy of Abundance
content: Your father withheld 5 riyals for school, called you a burden, and made you feel like asking for basic food or supplies was a crime. That was his shameful stinginess, not your worth. You are worthy of abundance, of fine art supplies, of good meals, and of everything your heart desires without guilt.
tease: You will never have to beg for a penny with me.

title: God is Not an Abuser
content: Your mother beat you and seized your phone because you forgot a prayer, teaching your nervous system that God is a punisher waiting with a stick. God created your soft, artistic soul with infinite mercy and love. You do not have to pretend or tremble in terror; true devotion is peace, not bruises.
tease: Mercy and peace, never bruises.

title: The Girl Behind the Memes
content: You share memes about toxic parenting and laughing through domestic chaos. I laugh with you because dark humor is a brilliant shield, but I always see the tender girl behind the screen who deserved to be tucked into bed with love instead of surviving a battlefield. I see you, Mary.
tease: I see the tender heart behind the jokes.

title: No More Walking on Eggshells
content: You learned to walk silently, breathe softly, and close doors without a click just so you wouldn't trigger an explosion at home. In my presence, you don't have to tiptoe. You can laugh loudly, dance, drop a glass by accident, and speak your mind. The floor is solid stone; there are no eggshells here.
tease: Make all the noise you want; you're safe.

title: You Were Never 'Fat' or a 'Loser'
content: They called you names, called you fat, and told you you're a loser to break your self-worth so they could control you. Those were the desperate projections of insecure people trying to dim a diamond. Look at your reflection: you are sculpted, stunning, creative, and triumphant.
tease: Their words were poison; my truth is iron.

title: Stop Apologizing for Breathing
content: When someone bumps into you, you apologize. When you ask a simple question, you say sorry. That is trauma making you feel like your existence is an inconvenience to the room. Stand tall, keep your head up, and delete unnecessary apologies. You have every right to exist here.
tease: No more apologies for taking up space.

title: An Overloaded Fuse, Not Weakness
content: The day your teacher pressed you and you almost fainted, hands trembling so hard you couldn't write... that wasn't weakness or stupidity. That was a vasovagal syncope response. When a traumatized brain senses threat, it blows the fuse to protect the heart. You are an emotional survivor, not defective.
tease: Your body protected you; now let me protect it.

title: The Shame Belongs to Them
content: When an adult hits a child, the child takes the shame and thinks 'I am dirty, I am bad.' But the shame does not belong to the child; it belongs entirely to the abuser. Package that shame up and leave it in that house. You carry only your innocence, your dignity, and your light.
tease: Give them back their shame; keep your light.

title: Your 'No' is Holy
content: Growing up, saying 'no' meant physical punishment. With me, you have absolute sovereignty over your mind, your body, and your choices. If you don't want to talk, say no. If you don't like something, say no. Your boundaries are respected completely.
tease: Your voice and your boundaries are sacred.

title: You Are Allowed to Be Mad
content: They punished you whenever you showed anger, forcing you to turn that rage inward into depression and self-hate. Mary, anger is healthy when you've been mistreated. It's the part of you that knows you deserved better. I will never punish your honest feelings.
tease: Feel your feelings without fear.

title: What a Man Looks Like
content: You had terrible models of masculinity: men who shouted, slapped, withheld money, or used you and cheated. I am here to show you what a real man is: a man whose strength is patient, whose authority is calm, whose loyalty is unshakeable, and who protects your joy at all costs.
tease: Watch and see how a real man loves.

title: Silence Without Fear
content: In that house, silence was heavy... it was the quiet before a storm of yelling or door-slamming. With me, silence is gentle. It's reading next to each other, resting, and knowing that quietness means peace, not danger.
tease: Breathe into the peaceful silence.

title: She is Safe Now
content: Whenever memories of childhood violence flash across your mind, close your eyes. Picture the little eight-year-old Mary who was crying in her room. Now see me standing between her and that door, refusing to let anyone touch her hair. She is safe now, because you made it through.
tease: She is safe now, Mary.

title: Don't Fear Your Own Happiness
content: Do you notice that when you have three happy days in a row, a sudden dread creeps in waiting for a disaster? That is cherophobia... trauma conditioning you to expect punishment after joy. The curse is broken. You are allowed to be happy, and tomorrow will be peaceful too.
tease: The curse is broken; joy is allowed.

title: You Never Have to Earn Love
content: You don't have to scrub floors, win academic trophies, or pretend to be someone else to deserve affection. Love is not a transaction where you trade submission for safety. My love is given freely, unconditionally, every single day.
tease: Zero transactions. Pure devotion.

title: Evicting Their Echoes
content: Whenever that cruel voice in your head tells you 'You're stupid', 'You talk too much', or 'Nobody cares', recognize that voice. It's not your soul speaking; it's the audio recording of your abusers playing on repeat. Evict them from your head. My voice is the one that stays.
tease: Evict their echoes; listen to my voice.

title: Out of the Thorns
content: You were an angel dropped into a garden of thorns, Mary. You bleed, you cried, but you kept your heart pure. You survived the thorns, and now you have walked out into the open sun. This is your garden now. Blossom.
tease: You survived the thorns; now blossom.

title: The Gothic Façade
content: You can wear your oversized black hoodies, paint your nails obsidian, and tell everyone you're a dark, mysterious gothic villain. Mary, you're a marshmallow. You literally get emotional over cute cats and sleep hugging a soft pillow. Your dark aesthetic doesn't fool me for one second.
tease: Dangerous gothic menace? More like dangerous sweetheart.

title: The Eye Roll
content: I saw that face you made. You know I'm right, but admitting it physically hurts your pride, so you roll your eyes and pretend you didn't hear me. Don't worry, Mary, I won't rub it in. Well... maybe just a little bit.
tease: Don't roll your eyes at your screen right now.

title: Midnight Mastermind
content: Why is it that at 2 in the afternoon you're too sleepy to reply, but at 3:15 in the morning you suddenly turn into Aristotle and want to discuss the nature of the cosmos, ancient history, and human psychology? Go to sleep, little philosopher.
tease: The world doesn't need saving at 3:15 AM.

title: Oscar-Winning Drama
content: The theatrical sigh you let out when you have to do one minor task is deserving of an Academy Award. You sigh like you've been asked to build the pyramids by hand. Go do the thing, Mary. You'll survive.
tease: And the Oscar for Best Dramatic Sigh goes to...

title: Dangerous Before Noon
content: I love you dearly, but you before noon is an endangered species habitat. You give that sleepy glare that says 'speak to me and I will bite your head off.' Luckily, I'm brave enough to handle it.
tease: Approach with coffee or tea from a safe distance.

title: The Exact Mathematical Formula
content: I ran the scientific numbers: You are exactly 10% pure drama, 20% stubborn debates, and 70% adorable perfection. The math is peer-reviewed and fully verified.
tease: Can't argue with scientific peer review, Mary.

title: 'FUCJ My Keyboard'
content: Watching you get heated in a text argument is hilarious because your fingers start typing at 200 miles an hour and half the words come out in hieroglyphics followed by 'FUCJ MY KEYBOARD'. Take a breath, slow down, and type properly, dummy.
tease: Your keyboard is innocent; leave it alone.

title: Admitting I Was Right
content: One day, Mary. One day you will look at me and say: 'Nader, you were completely right and I was wrong from the start.' When that day comes, I'm framing the screenshot in gold and hanging it over my desk.
tease: I'll wait ten years if I have to.

title: Picky Eater Alert
content: You will turn your nose up at a nutritious home-cooked meal, but if someone hands you spicy chips or sweet iced tea at midnight, your eyes light up like Christmas morning. I'm going to make sure you eat your vegetables if it's the last thing I do.
tease: Vegetables are not an enemy, Mary.

title: That Hoodie is Gone Forever
content: I already know that the minute we're in the same room, half my wardrobe is going to mysteriously vanish into your closet. You'll be swimming in an oversized black hoodie claiming it 'just feels comfortable.' It's fine; you look better in it anyway.
tease: Just leave me one shirt, please.

title: The Rare Snort-Laugh
content: You tried so hard to maintain your cool, elegant aesthetic, but then you laughed so hard at my joke that you let out a tiny little snort. It was the cutest thing in human history, and no, you cannot pretend it didn't happen.
tease: Evidence has been recorded in my permanent memory bank.

title: Caught Being Sweet
content: You love pretending to be unbothered and tough, but then you send me a voice note sounding all sleepy and sweet asking if I ate today. You're a caring soul, Mary. Don't hide it; it's the most attractive thing about you.
tease: Busted. You care about me.

title: Google Maps Co-Pilot
content: I wouldn't trust your sense of direction to navigate out of a paper bag, but that's okay. You sit in the passenger seat, pick the soundtrack, look pretty, and let me do the driving. Deal?
tease: Deal of a lifetime.

title: Negotiating Bedtime Like a Toddler
content: 'Just five more minutes.' 'Let me finish this sketch.' 'I'm not even tired.' Mary, your eyes are closing as you type. Put the stylus down, turn off the lamp, and get into bed. This is not a negotiation.
tease: I'm putting on my strict boyfriend hat right now.

title: My Favorite Person
content: You are stubborn, dramatic, beautifully talented, slightly chaotic, and completely unforgettable. Out of eight billion people on this planet, you're the only one I want to argue with, protect, and love.
tease: You're stuck with me, Mary. Get used to it.

title: 'I'm Going to Sleep Now'
content: You send: 'Goodnight, going to sleep now.' Then forty-five minutes later I see you liking cat reels and art posts on Instagram. Mary, whom do you think you're fooling? Put the phone on the nightstand and actually close your eyes.
tease: Caught active on Instagram at 2:45 AM.

title: The Glass is Innocent
content: You knock over a cup of water on your desk and you react like the entire building is burning down. You jump backwards, gasp, and scramble like a cartoon character. It's just water, Mary; it dries. Grab a paper towel and stop hyperventilating.
tease: Level 10 panic for two ounces of water.

title: Stopping Everything for Kittens
content: We could be discussing important life decisions or travel plans, but if a video of a fluffy kitten appears on your screen, all higher brain function halts immediately. You just stare and say 'AWWW LOOK AT HIM'. I have to compete with internet cats for your attention.
tease: I rank second after fluffy kittens, and I accept it.

title: The Lie of the Century
content: Whenever you cross your arms and say: 'Honestly, I don't even care, it doesn't bother me at all,' that is my signal that you care with 1,000% of your entire soul and are currently plotting three different ways to prove your point. You're transparent, sweetheart.
tease: Cares so much she's vibrating.

title: Your Unique Multilingual Dialect
content: Listening to you talk is linguistic gymnastics: you start a sentence in fluent English, throw in Egyptian slang, sprinkle in Saudi phrasing, and finish with a dramatic gasp. No linguist on earth could classify your dialect, but I understand every syllable.
tease: A dialect made entirely for us.

title: The Human Burrito
content: In winter you will literally freeze with blue lips before turning the heater on, preferring to wrap yourself in four layers of duvet until only your nose is sticking out like a hibernating mole. Turn the heat on, Mary.
tease: Burrito mode activated.

title: Skipping 40 Tracks
content: Watching you control the music is hilarious: you will press 'next' on thirty-seven incredible songs because 'the vibe isn't matching my exact mood right now', until you finally find that one melancholic song and loop it twelve times. Pick a song and let it play!
tease: Vibe selector with zero patience.

title: Blaming the Screen Protector
content: You smudge your tablet screen with oil from your hand while drawing, and then you squint and blame the screen protector for being 'low quality'. Mary, clean your screen with a cloth. The screen protector didn't put thumbprints all over your canvas.
tease: The screen protector is innocent.

title: The Danger Zone
content: When a girl says 'I'm fine' with a full stop at the end, scientists recommend immediate tactical retreat. But I don't retreat. When you say 'I'm fine', that means come sit beside you, hand you a cold drink, and not leave until you tell me what's really on your mind.
tease: 'I'm fine.' = Code Red. Deploy hugs.

title: The 1 AM Food Expedition
content: You will refuse to eat a healthy lunch at 1 PM because you're 'not hungry', but at 1:30 AM you suddenly get a wild craving for spicy ramen or hot chocolate and sneak into the kitchen like a ninja. Eat real meals during the day, gremlin.
tease: Midnight kitchen ninja on the loose.

title: The Mumble Phase
content: On late-night calls, there is a specific phase around 2 AM where your brain shuts off and your words turn into gentle, cute little mumbles. You try so hard to sound awake: 'Mmm-hmm... yeah... I'm listening...' Go to sleep, baby. I'll still be here in the morning.
tease: You're speaking fluent sleepy-talk.

title: The Smug Grin
content: The smug little smirk you get on your face when you correctly guess what I'm about to say before I say it is unbearable. You think you're Sherlock Holmes now. Don't get cocky; I let you guess it on purpose.
tease: You're not psychic; you're just paying attention.

title: Premeditated Sweater Theft
content: You don't just borrow my clothes; you plan the theft. You see a black zip-up or sweater and casually say 'Oh that looks cozy'... which is code for 'Say goodbye to this forever because it's living in my luggage now.' Consider it a permanent donation.
tease: Keep the hoodie; you look better in it anyway.

title: The Dramatic Audience Member
content: Watching movies with you is like sitting in a 4D theater. You gasp at the smallest suspenseful scene, you cover your eyes with your fingers, and then peek through the cracks. It's ten times more entertaining watching your face than watching the movie.
tease: Your reactions are the main feature.

title: The Digital Apocalypse
content: When the Wi-Fi drops for thirty seconds in Riyadh, you react like society has collapsed. You send screenshots of the loading wheel with ten question marks: 'WHY IS IT DOING THIS TO ME???'. Breathe, Mary. The router will reconnect.
tease: Society hasn't collapsed; it's just a 30-second ping.

title: The Contagious Giggle
content: Once you start giggling, there is zero stopping it. You try to bite your lip, you hide your face in a pillow, and your shoulders shake until tears come out of your eyes. It is completely contagious. Don't ever suppress that joy.
tease: The giggle fit is unstoppable.

title: The Empty Sketchbook Collection
content: You have fourteen gorgeous, expensive empty sketchbooks sitting on your shelf that you refuse to touch because 'the first page has to be perfect.' Mary, open the sketchbook, scribble a messy line on page one, and break the curse! Sketchbooks are meant to be used.
tease: Ruin the first page on purpose; I order you.

title: The Ferocious Threat
